heading: Additional family assistance

tree.heading: Authority.—
tree.text: The Secretary of Defense may provide for the families of members of the armed forces serving on active duty, in addition to any other assistance available for such families, any assistance that the Secretary considers appropriate to ensure that the children of such members obtain needed child care, education, and other youth services.

tree.heading: Primary Purpose of Assistance.—
tree.text: The assistance authorized by this section should be directed primarily toward providing needed family support, including child care, education, and other youth services, for children of members of the armed forces who are deployed, assigned to duty, or ordered to active duty in connection with a contingency operation.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2011—Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 111–383 substituted “armed forces” for “Armed Forces”.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Pub. L. 107–314, div. A, title VI, § 652(b), Dec. 2, 2002, 116 Stat. 2581, provided that: “Section 1788 of title 10, United States Code, as added by subsection (a), shall take effect on October 1, 2002.”

notes.heading: Pilot Program on Parent Education To Promote Early Childhood Education for Dependent Children Affected by Military Deployment or Relocation of Military Units
notes.text: Pub. L. 109–364, div.
